name: vexicon
description: General knowledge store for Claude Code: store and search notes, facts, and reference material in named spaces. Runs the vexicon hybrid vector + keyword Chroma MCP server.

lessons_space.title: Lessons space
lessons_space.description: Space where the learn skill stores lessons

embedding_repo_id.title: Embedding model
embedding_repo_id.description: Model a skill uses when it creates a space. With a GPU, pick multi-qa-mpnet-base-cos-v1. On CPU only, pick the smaller multi-qa-MiniLM-L6-cos-v1.

device.title: Device
device.description: Device that runs the embedding model. Auto uses a GPU when one is present.
